title: Naturality of the fixed comparison for inverse-image opens
statement:
For every smaller base open V ≤ W and open U of Y=f inverse W whose inclusion image equals f inverse V, the fixed comparison c on top sections admits an additive comparison d on U commuting with restriction. This is a statement about [def-pc-resolution-open-comparison-map], [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices] and [def-sc-open-module-cohomology].

theorem resolution_open_restriction_natural {X T : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ T) (F : X.Modules) (I : InjectiveResolution F) (q : ℕ)
    (W : T.Opens) (R : RestrictedResolutionSections I (f ⁻¹ᵁ W))
    (V : T.Opens) (hVW : V ≤ W) (U : (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme.Opens)
    (hU : (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι ''ᵁ U = f ⁻¹ᵁ V) :
    let K := ((pushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex
    let P := sectionCohomologyPresheaf K q
    let Y := (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme
    let G := (restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj F
    let c := resolutionOpenComparison f F I q W R
    ∃ d : P.obj (op V) ≃+
      (RingedSpace.openModuleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace q U).obj G,
      ∀ x : P.obj (op W),
        (RingedSpace.openModuleCohomologyRestriction Y.toRingedSpace q
          (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤))).app G (c x) =
            d ((P.map (homOfLE hVW).op).hom x)

proof.text: Compute U-open cohomology using the given R.resolution on Y, with no second restriction of injectives. Compose its right-derived section comparison, the U-section image of R.comparison, restrictAppIso followed by hU, and the exact evaluation/homology comparison; invert this isomorphism to define d. R.components pins the top comparison to resolutionOpenComparison. Naturality of R.comparison and the presheaf restriction maps gives the degreewise section-complex square. Apply ShortComplex.homologyMap_mapNatTrans and InjectiveResolution.rightDerived_app_eq, then cancel comparison inverses. This is the argument of the existing private rawOpenIso_restriction, generalized to an arbitrary pinned R.

proof_origin.place: private rawOpenIso_restriction and homology_restriction_transport; generalized to R.comparison and R.components; Stacks Tags 01E1, 01E2 and 01E4
